title: std_ext FragmentReceiver: unwrap_or(0) masks rule_id invariant violations
description: In rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs std_ext module, lines 1231/1249/1274 use self.rule_id.unwrap_or(0) when constructing ACK/NACK. While rule_id is always Some at these sites in correct usage, if a future bug left it as None, this would silently construct an ACK with rule_id=0 (invalid per check_rule) that only fails at wire serialization time with FragmentError::InvalidRuleId. Contrast with no_std FragmentReceiver line 1000 which uses self.rule_id? for proper error propagation. Fix: use self.rule_id.expect("rule_id must be set") or self.rule_id.unwrap() to expose invariant violations immediately.
